scripts.icons: node tools/make-icons.mjs && npx -y @capacitor/assets@3.0.5 generate --assetPath mobile/assets --androidProject mobile/android --iosProject mobile/ios/App --iconBackgroundColor '#ff8a3d' --splashBackgroundColor '#0e3d4f' --splashBackgroundColorDark '#0e3d4f' --android --ios
scripts.android:apk: npm run cap:sync && cd mobile/android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run cap:sync && cd mobile/android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.ios:open: npm run cap:sync && cap open ios
